gaps.explanation: Statement p5 Total revenues 4,563,361 = General 1,937,456 + Street 576,883 + Sales Tax 565,551 + Debt Service 1,046,173 + Capital Projects 397,428 + Other Fund (Keno) 39,870. Detail: GF departments pp14-17 1,937,456 (ties) + Street budget schedule p10 579,280 + Sales Tax p11 512,783 + Debt Service p12 1,038,646 + Capital Projects p13 397,428 (ties) = 4,465,593. The Keno column (Lottery proceeds 38,808 + Interest income 1,062 = 39,870) has no schedule: add both lines. Remaining 57,898 is budgetary vs GAAP: Street 576,883 - 579,280 = -2,397 (sales tax 127,403 vs 129,800); Sales Tax 565,551 - 512,783 = 52,768 (sales tax 338,200 vs 285,432); Debt Service 1,046,173 - 1,038,646 = 7,527 (property 531,327 vs 531,915; sales 241,670 vs 233,555). 4,465,593 + 39,870 = 4,505,463; 4,563,361 - 4,505,463 = 57,898 = -2,397 + 52,768 + 7,527 (different basis, no fix).
